comparison.objective: Follow a person while co-carrying and placing a pipe; candidate independently commissions and validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Human-led cooperative load handling and stand placement differ from recessed-tool engagement, fine collar rotation, relocking, and iterative dynamic-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Pipe must reach two stands and be released; candidate requires quantified impact-energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and lock-retention checks. Pipe alignment and safety thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Cooperative transport tests a different ability from mechanical adjustment and commissioning.
